question.id: Kamu menyiapkan buy EUR/USD di dekat support. Cara mana saja untuk meletakkan stop loss yang sesuai materi?
question.en: You're preparing a EUR/USD buy near support. Which ways of placing the stop loss match the lesson?

text.id: Angka tetap, misalnya selalu 20 pip, adalah metode yang paling disarankan.
text.en: A fixed number, such as always 20 pips, is the most recommended method.

text.id: Berdasarkan struktur: untuk buy, sedikit di bawah swing low atau support.
text.en: From structure: for a buy, a little below the swing low or support.

text.id: Tentukan dulu jumlah uang yang ingin dipertaruhkan, lalu letakkan SL sesuai jumlah itu.
text.en: First decide how much money you want to stake, then place the SL to match.

text.id: Sisakan buffer beberapa pip di luar level penting dan perhitungkan spread.
text.en: Leave a buffer of a few pips beyond the key level and allow for the spread.

text.id: Berdasarkan volatilitas: jarak SL beberapa kali ATR.
text.en: From volatility: an SL distance of a few times the ATR.
